verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's features page claims live shipping rates from leading carriers and options to print labels at home, and the shipping docs refer to label costs paid to carriers and later adjustments, which implies in-platform label purchase. Shipment tracking is never mentioned, and the rates and labels evidence is marketing-level with no setup detail, carrier list or confirmation of whether these are core or extension features. Missing for 10: any evidence of shipment tracking, in-depth docs on carrier-rate setup at checkout and the label-buying workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
